Name: River Extension For Crab Pod
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[quote][center][color=#f4f4f4][size=5]I created this mod as a river-themed counterpart to [/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#f4f4f4][size=5][b]"[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11594]Beach Extension For Crab Pod[/url]"[/b].[/size][/color][/center]
[/quote]This mod adds a new riverside area with wooden scaffolds designed for easy Crab Pot placement.
You can access the new area by interacting with the motorcycle on the road in the Backwoods.

Various options can be customized through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url], including the scaffold type and the respawn timing of the stumps in the custom area.

If [b]"[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11594]Beach Extension For Crab Pod[/url]"[/b] is also installed, you can enable an integration option that allows you to travel by boat between this custom area and the beach scaffold. This option is disabled by default.

The i18n files currently include [b]English (default)[/b] and [b]Japanese [/b]and[b] Portuguese[/b].
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Portuguese translation.
Thanks to "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Stardevalerio/mods]Stardevalerio[/url]" for sharing the file!
